issue.title: Pass missing properties to Hibernate Reactive startup

body: @agreedSkiing I created https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/29981 but I have no idea if it will actually fix your issue :).
Reopening this one as IIUC there's more to it.

@gsmet , @agreedSkiing let's remember that Hibernate Reactive does not use JDBC at all and this is specificcally tied to the JDBC driver layer: I wouldn't expect this to work.

That said, we should make this much clearer; perhaps log some warnings if such JDBC settings are being set rather than silently ignoring them - or perhaps fail fast with a more visile error. cc/ @DavideD should we raise this as an improvement on HR ?
@Sanne true it uses the `vertx-reactive:postgresql` datasource connection instead, but aren’t most of the propriety names just reusing legacy names for easier conversion or something like that?
